primeDirective: Product acceptance outcomes anchor work; activity, CI and review monitoring are not substitute deliverables.

scopes.universalRequests: An explicit owner request for ALL apps is captured as one Hub-owned cross-app requirement with source, acceptance, impact, risk, version and ratification route; do not copy authoritative laws or prompts into each application.
scopes.perProject: Product repositories own implementation, user journeys, tests and evidence; Project Profile/Work Packages/Quality Gates remain in Hub's canonical stores.
scopes.management: Application-Management owns app catalog/lifecycle metadata and truthful launch contract, never canonical project/RU03/Production authority.
